Cricketer Akash Deep Marries Akshita Raj in Varanasi

Indian cricketer Akash Deep is marrying Akshita Raj in Varanasi today. The wedding ceremonies have been ongoing for four days in Baddi village, Rohtas district. Akshita Raj hails from Manikpur, Dehri, and the wedding celebration is being held at a five-star hotel, with several celebrities expected to attend.
